George Peng's 2025 championship recap specifies 15 g coffee, 210 g water, a 40 ppm water profile, and a Solo Dripper with Melodrip. It uses 30 g at 96°C for bloom, 90 g at 96°C at 0:30, then 90 g at 80°C at 1:10, completing at 1:45. The recap associates the hot stages with development and sweetness, and the cooler gentle final phase with floral preservation and reduced turbulence. It also reports three roast temperatures as degrees Fahrenheit; that unit is physically implausible for coffee roasting, so it is not treated as reliable evidence.
